answer_1.quote: In this work, we introduce a personalized Reddit dataset PER-CHAT, an open-domain response generation dataset consisting of 1.5M conversations and 300k users.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses to input questions in conversations

answer_2.quote: We evaluated the baselines and our generative split memory network using several widely-used metrics, including perplexity, BLEU, and BERTScore... In addition to the aforementioned evaluation metrics, we also designed a metric called Profile Consistency Score (PC-Score)...

answer_4.quote: We conduct manual annotations to examine the consistency of those models... we generated 200 responses from each model, and asked annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk to judge such consistency based on two criteria...
answer_4.guideline: Raters were asked to rate between 1 to 3 for model consistency and determine personalization consistency by matching generated sentences to user profiles or comments.
